mapper.select: SELECT game_id, skill_key, formula_key, name, description, sort_order, NULL::text AS expression, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC, formula_key ASC

SELECT game_id, skill_key, formula_key, name, description, sort_order, expression::text AS expression, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key = #{formulaKey}

SELECT game_id, skill_key, formula_key, name, description, sort_order, expression::text AS expression, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key = #{formulaKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skill_formulas SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, expression = CAST(#{expression} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key = #{formulaKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key = #{formulaKey}
DELETE FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE nodes(node) AS ( SELECT expression FROM public.skill_formulas WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND formula_key = #{formulaKey} UNION ALL SELECT child.node FROM nodes parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN parent.node->>'nodeType' = 'OPERATION' THEN parent.node->'operands' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) AS child(node) ) SELECT DISTINCT node->>'attributeOwner' AS attribute_owner, node->>'attributeKey' AS attribute_key, node->>'attributeValueKind' AS attribute_value_kind FROM nodes WHERE node->>'nodeType' = 'ATTRIBUTE'
